final: SELECT tr.transreg AS transaction_reference, tr.ordertypedist AS order_type_mix, AVG(sf.shortintrt) AS avg_short_interest_days_to_cover, AVG(sf.optvolrt) AS avg_option_volume_ratio, AVG(sf.shortintrt) / (SELECT AVG(sf2.shortintrt) FROM sentimentandfundamentals sf2 JOIN transactionrecord tr2 ON tr2.transreg = sf2.transref WHERE tr2.ordertypedist = tr.ordertypedist) AS short_interest_ratio FROM transactionrecord tr JOIN sentimentandfundamentals sf ON sf.transref = tr.transreg GROUP BY tr.transreg, tr.ordertypedist ORDER BY short_interest_ratio IS NULL, short_interest_ratio DESC LIMIT 10
